What is live, and what is not

The front desk works today: it answers, qualifies, takes the job down, and sends you the summary. Direct calendar booking, lead generation, win-back campaigns and the wider Revenue Engine are in development and labelled that way everywhere on this site.

Next step

Find out what your missed calls are costing.

Can it book directly into my calendar?

Not yet, and we will not pretend otherwise. The assistant takes the job, the address and the time the caller wants, then texts it to you so you can confirm the slot. Direct calendar booking is on the roadmap and is not live on any line today.

What does it cost?

A short strategy call covers your call patterns, what NEVAMIS would handle, and a quote scoped to your volume.

Book a strategy call

NEVAMIS finds where revenue is leaking, puts a range on what each leak is worth, and runs the fixes inside rules you approve. Revenue recovery and a round-the-clock front desk are how it acts today. Lead generation is in development.
